# SAP Commerce Cloud Command Line Interface

A command line interface to initiate build and deploy actions in SAP Commerce
Cloud outside of the Cloud Portal, see [SAP Support page](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_COMMERCE_CLOUD_PUBLIC_CLOUD/9116f1cfd16049c3a531bfb6a681ff77/8acde53272c64efb908b9f0745498015.html?locale=en-US&version=LATEST).

Please download a valid ZIP archive from your the SAP download center using a
query [CXCOMMCLI](https://me.sap.com/softwarecenter/search/CXCOMMCLI).
